jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager  | Germany | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

 

The Opportunity:

We’re looking for an enthusiastic, tech-forward product marketer to grow our Observability products by boldly positioning them and running campaigns to attract, convert and retain customers. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will be in charge of the messaging and positioning for a broad product area. Then you’ll work closely with product managers and the marketing team to deliver campaigns, content, events, and training that help buyers buy (and sellers sell) our value.

Product Marketing lives within the Product org rather than the Marketing org at Grafana Labs, and we think differently about the job. Rather than purely executing launches or campaigns, we want PMMs to teach product managers and engineers in our org how to think about growth and demand, and to codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone in the organization can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks.

Grafana Labs is a fast-paced and growing organization. As such, this role requires strategic skills, an interest in teaching, and hands-on tactical execution (blogs, webinar outlines, video scripts, etc). Our team is full of people who crave impact and independence - if you are seeking a role with narrow scope where you run a defined playbook, this is not the job for you.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Actively partner with and teach product managers to define product value, messaging, and go-to-market strategy, from competitive positioning to sales enablement collateral.
  • Partner with product management, engineering and various go-to-market functions to create materials that help customers evaluate and adopt our products: reference architectures, implementation guides, detailed product information and more.
  • Own customer lifecycle campaigns (competitive positioning, retention, upsell/cross-sell) to strategically shape marketing programs and drive growth across the entire customer journey.
  • Conduct market and customer research to understand pain points, competition and opportunities.
  • Teach go-to-market and sales teams our products’ capabilities and the value they provide, deliver training and enablement, ensure customer facing teams are able to effectively engage with customers, partners, and prospects.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 4+ years of relevant experience (product marketing, solutions marketing, product management)
  • Experience with marketing and selling to a technical audience
  • A passion for open source, cloud native, and infrastructure technologies 
  • Proven ability to take on complex projects and efficiently drive them from start to finish
  • Ability to clearly articulate the value of technical products to customers and sellers alike
  • Experience leading product or feature launches autonomously as well as part of a team
  • Experience working with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to automate messaging and workflows
  • Comfort working with a variety of internal and external stakeholders in complicated processes
  • Strong pr

jobs.title: Senior Application Product Manager - Supply Chain - Procurement
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

The Celonis Business Apps Supply Chain team is an innovative group of product and technology enthusiasts focused on creating and deploying next-generation solutions in the Supply Chain domain. We are transforming how enterprise solutions are built driven by our customers' business critical problems. Our team strikes an ideal balance between deep technical execution (including advanced data engineering and AI tooling) and a sharp customer focus to create highly impactful products that accelerate value realization across our customer base.

The Role:

You will gain experience in the Supply Chain and related processes and act as the interface between customers, our Go-To-Market and our Product & Engineering teams, shaping the future of Celonis’ product offering in this domain. Take this chance to rethink the way companies run their Supply Chain processes, with a specific focus on Procurement and help our customers to accelerate their value realization with Celonis.

As an Application Product Manager for Procurement, you will operate at the intersection of customer-facing solution engineering and core product innovation to architect and deploy cutting-edge enterprise AI solutions. In this hybrid role, you will partner directly with strategic customers to build bespoke, composable procurement and supply chain architectures using the Celonis Context Model (CCM) and advanced decision intelligence. By leveraging modern AI tooling and LLM-based coding agents, you will abstract field insights into reusable semantic libraries, directly accelerating Celonis' global agentic deployment workflows. You get hands-on: prototyping on the platform, wiring up data, building AI-driven solutions, and iterating directly with the people who'll use them.

The work you’ll do:

Your mission is to make the vision of AI-powered solutions a reality by building products that turn the cutting edge capabilities of the Celonis  Platform from strategy into solutions that customers use to run their Procurement processes.

  • Discovery & Solution Blueprinting: Conduct collaborative discovery workshops to uncover root-causes and operational inefficiencies, mapping ambiguous customer needs into clear technical scopes and comprehensive solution blueprints.
  • Context Model & Solution Deployment: Execute hands-on deployments of customer-specific context models, data structures, and end-to-end supply chain blueprints within the Celonis platform.
  • Project Management & Customer Value: Own customer deployments end-to-end from initial kickoff to live production, presenting complex architectural solutions and strategic value narratives directly to cross-functional stakeholders and executive teams.
  • Prototype & Test Functions: Design, validate, and test use-case-specific decision intelligence functions, including e.g. optimization algorithms and predictive models.
  • Context Generation: Deconstruct monolithic application architectures and translate deployment learnings into reusable semantic entities and modular context libraries.

If you are passionate about Procurement, Supply Chain, the Celonis technology, and what it can do for our customers, here's your chance to directly contribute to taking our Celonis Platform and Context Model to the next level.

The qualifications you need:

  • 4+ years of experience as a Solution Engineer, Product Engineer, Technical Product Manager, Founding/Forward-Deployed Engineer, Implementation Consultant or a comparable technical, customer-facing role hybrid role.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of core operational workflows in supply chain and procurement. You can speak the language of C-suite executives and seamlessly connect complex, systemic bottlenecks to strategic AI solutions.
  • A track record of building coherent solutions, not just isolated features. You think in terms of the whole solution and how the pieces fit together.
  • Expert in dat

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
About Orakl Oncology 
 Every cancer patient deserves a treatment that works for them. Today, too many never get one in time: fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs make it through clinical trials and every failure costs patients precious time .
 Orakl exists to change those odds.
 We bridge biological and artificial intelligence by building large cohorts of virtual cancer patients: real patients’ tumors, paired with their medical history and deep biological data. By combining patient-derived tumor models, deep biological data and AI, we help pharmaceutical companies predict how cancer drugs will perform in patients, identify promising treatments and make better decisions earlier in development.
 We were founded in 2023 by Fanny Jaulin, PhD, Diane-Laure Pagès, PhD and Gustave Ronteix, PhD as a spin-out from Gustave Roussy, one of Europe's leading cancer centers, building on a decade of research. We are backed by top international VC investors and we are scaling our technology and partnerships with pharmaceutical companies worldwide.
 Discover more here: Orakl's website .
 
 The role 
 We are looking for Orakl's first Product Marketing Lead to shape how we bring our technology to market, from understanding our customers and positioning our offerings to building the commercial narratives and tools that help us win.
 You will sit at the intersection of science, product and business development, turning complex scientific capabilities into compelling propositions for pharma and biotech customers.
 Your job is to understand what our customers need, articulate why Orakl is uniquely positioned to deliver it, and help translate our technology into offerings that customers understand, trust and buy.

 9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.
 Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

 Work with data scientists and ML engineers to bridge the gap between business needs and the technical capabilities of AI models

 Communicate strategy, initiatives, and progress transparently across the organisation

 Translate complex AI concepts, capabilities, and limitations into language that non-technical stakeholders can act on

 Champion responsible AI practices: transparency in model outputs, bias monitoring, and compliance with client expectations around AI-generated content

jobs.title: Senior MarTech Product Manager (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
Our story:
 Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.
 
 Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

 Role summary
 You own the marketing-technology layer behind Taxfix's growth: the conversion signals that tell ad networks who converted, the customer data that powers CRM, the consent flows that decide what we may share and with whom, and the referral program, one of the growth mechanics the team owns end to end. This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. You set direction for a small engineering team (a tech lead plus 3–4 engineers, two-week sprints) that supports four products across three markets, with Paid Acquisition, CRM, Brand and Creative as internal customers. A typical week mixes debugging a missing ad-network event, scoping a referral reward, settling a data-sharing question with Legal, and explaining trade-offs to leadership. All work, including across markets, happens in English; German is not required.
 
 What you'll do
 Own conversion-signal engineering for paid acquisition: client-side and server-to-server events into Singular, Firebase/GA4, Google Ads and TikTok, including synthetic events, revenue values and predicted-LTV signals.

 Run the referral program as a product: reward mechanics, eligibility and fraud rules, voucher infrastructure (Voucherify), the in-app voucher wallet, entry points, and the experiments that tune them.

 Grow push and marketing-consent opt-in through permission primers, iOS/Android OS permission flows and notification preferences.

 Keep CRM data trustworthy: Braze attributes and events, Snowflake-to-Braze syncs, event-loss monitoring, and moving legacy messaging (SendGrid, Firebase) onto Braze.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Platform
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to take on the hardest problems in the data and integration platform that everything at Nelly runs on: how practice data gets into Nelly from dozens of practice management systems, how partners connect to us, and how that data becomes something every product can depend on. At Staff level, your scope follows the problem, across teams and over time into product-wide questions.
 The problem space: Every Nelly product, from documentation to billing to payments, depends on data that lives in a practice's management system. There are dozens of them, each with its own data model and interfaces. 
 How many practices we can serve, how much of their work we can automate, and how much they trust the result come down to four questions: can we connect, can we read and write deeply enough, is the data any good once it arrives, and can every product and team inside Nelly easily build on it?
 About Nelly 
 We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.
 Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.
 What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.
 
 Joining us, you will: 
 Own the strategy, metrics and roadmap for hard data and integration problems, from how data leaves a practice's system, through ingestion and modelling, to the products that rely on it, tied to real practice value and to how Nelly makes money

 Shape how partners connect to Nelly through our External API, so we can serve practices on any system and open new markets beyond Germany

 Define the core data every product relies on: what a patient, an appointment, a treatment plan or an invoice means, who owns it, and how fresh and reliable it is, with GDPR and health-data regulation built in from the start

 Make data and integration quality measurable and visible, and move it, because practices feel a silent failure long before we do

 Hold an end-to-end model of the platform and be a credible partner to engineering on architecture and trade-offs

 
 What you'll bring: 
 Agency. You go after the problems that matter most, including well beyond your immediate scope, rather than waiting for a roadmap to land on your desk

 Comfort in a high-velocity environment. You move fast, make bold but reversible calls, and challenge early and directly, including upward

 Business-outcome orientation. You're genuinely data-driven: you can name the metric each project moves and let evidence, not gut feel, drive prioritisation

 Technical fluency. You reason confidently about APIs, data models, data flows and how systems fit together, and you're a credible partner to senior engineers

 You build with AI. You use AI to move faster: prototyping to pressure-test an idea, taking a first pass on the analysis or the spec yourself, shipping the small things directly, so your time goes to judgment and the decisions that move the product

 7+ years of product management experience
 

 Even better if you have: 
 Built and shipped AI products

 Worked on data platforms or data products

 Built B2B SaaS in healthcare or another regulated industry

 Professional German language knowledge

 
 Our Interview Process: 
 Introduction to Nelly with TA

 Product craft interview with our Product manager

 Case study interview with Director of Product

 Onsite interview with hiring manager and stakeholders

 
 What we offer: 
 The people you get to work with. You will work alongside the brightest minds we could find, on hard problems, as a team. We take on challenges together and we never forget to have fun doing it.

 Room to grow faster than almost anywhere else. New challenges, more scope, real ownership from day one. We trust you to own it and to speak up when something is wrong. Just do not expect to stand still.

 A yearly learning and development budget , plus the coaching, feedback and internal knowledge that actually move you forward. Real investment

 You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

 From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

 Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

 You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

 Let’s make the invisible visible! 
  
  
 What will you do 
 Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements.

 Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months.

 Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team.

 Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements.

 For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans.

 Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines.

 Support go-to-market: give input on positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and documentation scope together with the applications, operations, and product development teams.

  
 What is expected of you 
 Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment.

 A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from.

 The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them.

 Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with the people designing the product, across mechanics, optics, electronics/RF, and software.

 Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning.

 We hire for demonstrated skill rather than a specific degree; a technical or scientific background is typical. The working language is English.

 Additional experience we value: 
 Semiconductor industry knowledge (fabs, IDMs, OSATs, inspection, metrology, or failure analysis).

 Familiarity with SEMI standards and fab tool integration (for example, S2/S8, E10, SECS/GEM).

 Experience selecting or setting up a requirements management tool (for example, Jama, Polarion, or CodeBeamer).

 A working understanding of quantum sensing, optics, or precision instrumentation.

  
 Our benefits 
 Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

 Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey,

jobs.title: Bid & Project Manager – EU & NATO (H/F)
jobs.description:
About Alta Ares
 
Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.
 Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
 Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.
 Role & Mission 
 NATO agencies & EU programs are investing in counter-drone capability now, and Alta Ares answers a fast-growing flow of their tenders and calls for proposals. As Bid & Project Manager in our EU, NATO & Eastern Flank team, you turn each opportunity into a compliant offer, then into a project delivered on time. Your sales director owns the customer relationship and the commercial strategy; you own the offer and its delivery.
 This is not a one-programme job. You will run several bids and projects at once: a NATO bid, an EU grant proposal, and an RFI can land in the same week, and none of them can slip.
 This is a demanding, high-ownership role. Deadlines do not move, the stakes are real, and the team will rely on you to hold the line. We are looking for someone who wants that responsibility.
 
 Bid Management - from first read to submission 
 Screen and qualify opportunities with your sales director; prepare bid/no-bid decisions with risks, resources, and price on the table

 Break each tender down (NATO IFB or RFQ, EU call, RFP for a Nation through EU-NATO platforms such as NSPA or SAFE joint procurement) into a compliance matrix, a bid plan and clear owners

 Write and assemble the management, technical and compliance volumes with Engineering, Product, Finance and Legal

 Organise the review gates and prepare the final price review with Finance; submit complete, compliant and on time, every time

 Run the clarification rounds and support your sales director in negotiations through to contract signature

 
 NATO & EU Procurement - the rules of the game 
 Master NSPA and NCIA procedures: Source File registration, declarations of eligibility, notifications of intent, IFBs and RFQs, basic ordering agreements and framework contracts

 Run EU grant proposals (European Defence Fund, EDIP): Funding & Tenders portal, consortium building, Part A and Part B, lump-sum budgets

 Track national procurement rules and partners on the Eastern Flank through EU-NATO (Poland, Romania, the Baltic States…), e.g. via NSPA or SAFE joint procurement

 Build and maintain the bid library: company documents, CVs, past performance, standard answers, templates

 
 Project Delivery - from award to acceptance 
 Turn each award into a project: kick-off, plan, milestones, risks, budget and change control

 Coordinate engineering, production, demo and logistics teams, and partners, to deliver what we promised when we promised it

 Own customer reporting, deliverables and acceptance (FAT/SAT), with the documentation trail for invoicing and audits

 Run several projects in parallel, each at a different stage

 
 Process & Reporting 
 Set the bid and project rhythm for the team: calendar, gates, templates, dashboards

 Review the status of every live bid and project weekly with your sales director: deadlines, compliance, risks, resources needed

 Run lessons learned after every bid, won or lost

 
 Candidate Profile 
 5+ years in bid, proposal or project management in defence, aerospace or security

 Proven record of compliant, on-time submissions to NATO agencies, EU programmes or European ministries of defence, several of them in parallel

 At least one defence contract delivered from award to acceptance

 Scale-up or lean-team experience is a significant advantage; prime experience is welcome if you want more breadth and speed

 Skills & Qualities 
 Rigorous and precise compliance is binary; in defence, the margin for error is zero

 Built for parallel work you run several bids and projects at once, prioritise hard and never drop the ball

 Committed you own the outcome, not just your part of it; submission peaks are part of the job and you plan for them

 Calm under pressure fixed deadlines, late amendments and competing requests do not throw you

 A clear writer structured, scoreable English; you turn engineering input into compliant answers

 A leader without authority you get engineers, Finance, Legal and partners to deliver on time

 Technically curious you understand how sensors, effectors, C2 and AI fit together, or you learn it fast

 Discreet and trustworthy you handle sensitive commercial and defence information as a matter of course

 Mission-driven you care about European security, not just the job title

 Nice to Have 
 APMP, Shipley, PMP, PRINCE2 or IPMA certification

 Experience on a European Defence Fund or EDIP consor

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
  
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
  
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
  

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
  

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
  

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
  

 Location 
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
  
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round

  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health. 
  
 Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.
 Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.
  
 About the role 
 As a Product Manager at Scarlet, you will own a meaningful product area end to end. You will develop a deep understanding of the people and problems within it, set a clear direction, decide what matters most, and work with product design and engineering to deliver measurable improvements.
 You will sit close to regulatory experts, account managers and customers in our London office. Their expertise will give you rich signals, but not a ready-made roadmap. Your job is to turn those signals into a coherent product strategy, make trade-offs openly and ensure what we build improves both the quality and speed of certification.
 You will have substantial autonomy. We will trust you to form a point of view, test it against evidence and change course when the evidence changes.
  
 Responsibilities 
 Own the strategy, roadmap and outcomes for a product area, from discovery and definition through launch, adoption and iteration.

 Partner closely with product design, engineering and regulatory experts to turn complex requirements into clear, trustworthy workflows.

 Spend time with customers and internal users to understand their work, observe friction and distinguish underlying problems from requested features.

 Prioritise across customer value, regulatory rigour, operational efficiency, technical constraints and Scarlet’s company goals.

 Keep the team aligned on the problem, the intended outcome and the trade-offs behind each decision.

 Communicate product direction, decisions, progress and learning clearly across Scarlet.

 Help improve how Scarlet practises product management as the team grows.

  
 Required qualifications 
 Evidence of owning and shipping complex products from discovery through delivery and iteration.

 Strong product judgement, including examples of difficult prioritisation choices made under real constraints.

 Enough technical fluency to work effectively with engineers on systems, data, APIs and the trade-offs of AI-enabled products.

 Clear, precise written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain complex decisions to different audiences.

 Comfort working in ambiguity, taking responsibility and updating your view when new evidence appears.

 High standards for product quality, reliability and trust.

  
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience in health technology, enterprise software, vertical SaaS or another regulated industry.

 Experience building products for complex, multi-stakeholder or expert-led workflows.

 Experience with AI-enabled products, including evaluation, failure modes and appropriate guardrails.

 Experience in an early-stage or fast-growing company where product practices were still being formed.

  
 Interview process 
 We typically collapse steps 3 to 5 into one in-person session.
 Intro chat with Johnny - 30 minutes

 Engineering and design chats with Niclas and Jono - 30 minutes each

 Problem solving session with a member of tech ops - 30 minutes

 Interview with Johnny - 30 minutes

 Culture interviews with the founders Jamie and James - 30 minutes each

 References and offer. 

  
 Application note 
 You do not need to meet every preferred qualification to apply. We are interested in the quality of your judgement, the outcomes you have helped create and the way you learn. If this role excites you and your experience has taken a different route, we would still like to hear from you.
 Compensation: £70K – £100K • Offers Equity

jobs.description:
About us
 People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. In reality, hundred of thousands of operators acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on, with tools that have barely changed in decades and spending hours a day on email. Nexcade is building the agentic operating system for those people, transforming the way people communicate and optimise the $1T spend on logistics every year.
 Our agents are live in production with leading global Freight Forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are rapidly expanding the platform to touch every part of the logistics lifecycle.
 Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality from top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.
 How we work
 Everybody builds, founders included. The whole company is technical and runs on coding agents. You will not be asked to write production software, but you will use agents for discovery synthesis, specs, prototypes and data analysis rather than doing them by hand.

 Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

 At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

 End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

 In person, in London. We value synchronous communication.

 Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

 Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

 The role
 We’re building the AI platform freight forwarders rely on. We started with quoting and are expanding across the shipment lifecycle. As Product Lead, you will be central to that expansion, helping decide where we focus and turning those decisions into products customers depend on.
 What you’ll do: 
 Own product outcomes: Own the roadmap, priorities and performance of specific products, from defining the customer problem through launch, rollout and adoption. Partner with the founders on overall product direction and strategy.

 Build from customer insight: Work closely with freight forwarders across commercial and operational roles. Understand how they work, identify the problems customers share and build products for those needs rather than one-off solutions.

 Prototype and build: Turn ideas into working prototypes and early product versions, using AI tools and code to test them with customers. Work hands-on with engineering to take promising ideas into production, not just write specs and hand them over.

 Drive product expansion: Build a clear view of the market, including where we win, where we do not compete and why customers choose us. Use that understanding to identify the next workflows Nexcade should enter and turn them into products that grow revenue.

 Raise the standard of product thinking: Define success measures, test assumptions and examine accuracy, edge cases and second-order effects before scaling. Write clear specs and decision documents, including a written recommendation on the hard calls.

 Build the product operating system: Establish a clear planning and decision-making cadence without adding bureaucracy. Make sure product meetings are well prepared, teams have the context they need and decisions translate into shipped work.

 Make product and platform trade-offs: Work closely with engineering to decide when to invest in shared capabilities and when a faster, product-specific approach is right.

 What we look for 
 Strong product judgement: You have owned meaningful product work in a complex B2B product and can show how your decisions changed customer behaviour or business results. You define success clearly and test assumptions, accuracy and edge cases before scaling.

 Product taste: You can turn complex workflows into products that feel simple, coherent and trustworthy. You care about the details that make people choose to use them.

 Technical fluency: You work effectively with strong engineers, understand trade-offs across architecture, AI, data and integrations and bring the customer and product perspective to choices about speed, quality and reuse.

 Excellent judgement: You get beyond what customers ask for to understand how their work really happens and distinguish repeatable needs from bespoke requests. You use customer and market insight to make product choices that drive adoption, expansion and revenue.

 High agency and directness: You take ownership, hold a high bar and disagree openly and constructively. You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration and changing priorities.

 Obsess over the problem: You are drawn to complex, messy problems in industries the economy depends on and want to understand how the people and systems behind them really work. Industry experience is a bonus, but not required.

 Auf Basis von Produktdaten sorgen wir dafür, dass Werbemittel automatisiert entstehen: Prospekte, Kataloge, Plakate und Online-Kampagnen, schneller und mit deutlich weniger Handarbeit.
 In dieser Rolle trägst Du ein Kundenvorhaben über die ganze Strecke: Du verstehst das Problem, entwirfst die Lösung, setzt sie selbst um und begleitest sie bis zur Abnahme. Projektmanagement, Beratung und Umsetzung liegen bei Dir in einer Hand. Das macht unsere Projekte schneller und für den Kunden günstiger.
 Früher hieß das: Konzept schreiben, an die Entwicklung übergeben, in Schleifen nachbessern. Bei uns bringst Du Dein Konzept mit KI selbst weit über den Prototyp hinaus und arbeitest dabei Hand in Hand mit unserer Entwicklung.
 Ganz ehrlich: Vieles in unserem neuen Team ist noch nicht fertig. Abläufe, Vorlagen und die Art, wie wir zusammenarbeiten, entstehen gerade. Wer hier einsteigt, legt selbst Hand an und gestaltet mit.
 Deine Aufgaben
 Projektverantwortung: Du verantwortest und steuerst Kundenprojekte: Umfang, Ablauf, Termine und kaufmännische Budgetverantwortung liegen in Deiner Hand.
 Beratung & Konzeption: Du berätst unsere Kunden zu fachlichen und technischen Fragen und entwickelst mit ihnen Konzepte, wie aus ihren Produktdaten automatisiert Werbemittel entstehen.
 Umsetzung mit KI: Einen großen Teil der Lösung baust Du mit KI selbst. Unsere Entwickler:innen arbeiten dabei eng mit Dir zusammen, prüfen Deine Umsetzung und bringen sie mit Dir in den Betrieb.
 Steuerung im Projekt: Du verantwortest das Anforderungsmanagement und priorisierst, was wann umgesetzt wird. Du sicherst Qualität und Termintreue, erkennst Risiken früh und schlägst Maßnahmen vor.
 Abnahme & Releases: Du führst Abnahme und Integration beim Kunden und begleitest Releases und Updates danach.
 Angebote & Abrechnung: Du erstellst projektbezogene Angebote, hältst Leistungen nach und bereitest die Abrechnung vor.
 Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit Produktentwicklung, Vertrieb und Marketing zusammen und bringst Erkenntnisse aus den Projekten ins Produkt zurück.
 Das bringst Du mit
 Studium: Du hast ein Studium mit guten Noten abgeschlossen, gern mit IT- oder Wirtschaftsbezug wie Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen.
 Projekterfahrung: Du hast bereits Projekte begleitet oder geführt, gern aus einer Beratung oder aus der Softwareentwicklung im Kundenumfeld.
 Analytisches Denken: Du durchdringst komplexe Anforderungen, erkennst das eigentliche Problem und entwickelst dafür eine tragfähige Lösung.
 Software-Strategie: Du verstehst, wie Softwarelösungen aufgebaut sind: Datenmodelle, Schnittstellen, Infrastruktur und Systemlandschaften. Dieses Verständnis befähigt Dich, Lösungen strategisch zu konzipieren, Kunden fundiert zu beraten und mit KI selbst zu entwickeln. Gerne mit eigener Programmiererfahrung.
 Lust auf KI: Du probierst neue KI-Tools aus, bevor jemand danach fragt, und willst herausfinden, wie man damit schneller und besser arbeitet. Für Dich ist KI das Werkzeug, mit dem aus einem Konzept direkt eine lauffähige Lösung wird.
 Kommunikation: Du schaffst Klarheit zwischen Kunde, Entwicklung und internen Teams, auch wenn Interessen auseinandergehen.
 Verbindlichkeit: Du triffst Entscheidungen, hältst Zusagen und meldest früh, wenn etwas aus dem Rahmen läuft.
 Sprachkompetenz: Du sprichst Deutsch verhandlungssicher und Englisch sicher.
 Das bieten wir Dir
 Wirkung: Lösungen für große Händler, an denen Deine Arbeit direkt sichtbar wird.
 Gestaltungsraum: Du bist früh dabei in einem neuen Team und prägst mit, wie es arbeitet.
 Alles in einer Hand: Beratung, Projektleitung und Umsetzung in einer Rolle, ohne die üblichen Übergabeverluste dazwischen.
 Rückendeckung: An den großen Weichenstellungen schaut Deine Teamleitung mit Dir gemeinsam auf die Lösung. Preisverhandlungen und harte Kostendiskussionen führt sie, damit Du Dich auf Kunde und Lösung konzentrieren kannst.
 Werkzeuge: KI-gestütztes Arbeiten gehört bei uns zum Alltag, nicht zum Pilotprojekt.
 Zusammenarbeit: flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege und Raum, Abläufe mitzugestalten.
 Standort: moderne Büroräume im Herzen Hamburgs, flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten.
 Vergütung: Wir bieten Dich eine leistungsgerechte Vergütung, die Deine Erfahrung, Dein Engagement und Deinen Impact widerspiegelt.
 Benefits on Top: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zusatzversicherungen, Wellpass, Jobrad und ein zertifiziert familienfreundliches Umfeld.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (EMEA)
jobs.description:
About Us 
 Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.
 Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.
 We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.
 Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.
 About the Position 
 We're looking for a proactive and highly organized Technical Project Manager to lead customer implementations across Constructor's product suite. You will lead onboardings for new customers as well as implementations of additional products for existing customers, owning each engagement from kickoff through activation. You will own the plan, the timeline, and the outcome, and you drive the people delivering it through a matrixed reporting structure. As we build toward an automation-first operating model, you will help standardize how implementations are run and increasingly act as a portfolio strategist, managing exceptions while repeatable, AI-assisted processes carry the routine work.
 You will: 
 • Lead multiple implementations end to end, both new-customer onboardings and additional-product rollouts for existing customers, from kickoff through integration, testing, and activation.
 • Take accountability for the outcome of every implementation, coordinating Constructor resources, customer resources, and partners, against a single shared plan.
 • Run kickoffs, set milestones, track dependencies, and maintain a clear, shared view of status for internal stakeholders and the customer.
 • Serve as the customer's primary point of contact through activation, setting expectations and communicating progress, risks, and changes in scope.
 • Identify risks and blockers early, escalate effectively, and keep implementations moving toward on-time, predictable delivery.
 • Ensure clean handoffs into implementation from Sales and out of implementation to Customer Success and Support.
 • Maintain implementation plans and reporting in our systems of record so schedule, duration, and status roll up cleanly across your portfolio.
 • Help build the repeatable processes, templates, and standards that let the function scale, and partner on the automation-first model as it matures.
 Role Responsibilities: Technical Project Management 
 • Own the Outcome: Be accountable for the success of each implementation from kickoff to activation, whether the work is delivered by Constructor, the customer, or a partner, standing behind on-time, predictable go-live for both new customers and existing-customer product rollouts.
 • Drive Every Contributor: Coordinate Constructor technical resources, customer resources, and partners against one plan, holding each accountable to their commitments through influence rather than authority.
 • Lead the Customer Experience: Serve as the primary point of contact through activation, running a clear communication rhythm and building customer confidence from kickoff to handoff.
 • Manage Handoffs & Risk: Ensure accurate handoffs from Sales into implementation and from implementation into Customer Success and Support, surfacing risk early and keeping delivery on track wherever the risk sits.
 • Build Scalable Process: Standardize how implementations are run at Constructor, maintain accurate tracking and reporting, and help advance the automation-first operating model as the function grows.
 Requirements 
 You Have 
 • At least 3 years of technical project management or onboarding project management experience, ideally in a SaaS environment.
 • A track record of owning delivery outcomes end to end and holding cross-functional contributors accountable through influence rather than direct authority.
 • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to run multiple implementations in parallel without losing the thread.
 • Customer-facing confidence: you can lead a kickoff, manage expectations, and kee

jobs.title: Product Owner – B2B SaaS (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über uns
 CALIMA ist ein Berliner B2B-SaaS-Startup mit der Mission, Arbeitssicherheit durch digitale und innovative Lösungen einfacher, verlässlicher und wirksamer zu machen. Unsere Software unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, dass Alleinarbeitende im Notfall schnell Hilfe erhalten. CALIMA wird von über tausend Unternehmen genutzt und schützt täglich tausende Mitarbeitende.
 Wir sind ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, produktnah und mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Dabei suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, mitdenken und unsere Prozesse aktiv verbessern.
 Deine Rolle
 Als Product Owner wirst du unsere erste fest angestellte Person im Produktmanagement und übernimmst die operative Produktverantwortung für unsere Entwicklungsteams: Cloud, Mobile Apps für iOS und Android sowie Platform.
 Aktuell liegen Backlog, Tickets und Planung direkt beim Head of Tech. Deine Aufgabe ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass die Teams verlässlich an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten: ein gut sortiertes Backlog, klar definierte Tickets, ein funktionierendes Refinement und realistisch abgestimmte Deadlines. Du wirst das Bindeglied zwischen dem Head of Tech, den kleinen, remote arbeitenden Entwicklungsteams, QA, Sales und Customer Success.
 Wir entwickeln ein sicherheitsrelevantes Produkt. Zuverlässigkeit und Qualität stehen bei uns vor Feature-Menge.
 Perspektivisch kannst du deine Rolle in Richtung strategisches Product Management weiterentwickeln und Themen wie Roadmap, Markt und Produktstrategie aktiv mitgestalten.
 Deine Aufgaben
 Backlog und Tickets
 Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus Customer Success, Sales und Support in Epics und Tickets und klärst offene Fragen.

 Du pflegst ein priorisiertes Backlog je Team und stellst sicher, dass nur klar definierte Tickets in die Entwicklung gehen.

 Du formulierst Tickets mit Ziel, Akzeptanzkriterien und Abgrenzung so, dass Entwicklung und QA ohne Rückfragen starten können.

 Konzeption
 Du leitest aus Kundenfeedback und Anfragen von Sales und Customer Success ab, welches Problem dahintersteht und welche Verbesserung den größten Nutzen bringt.

 Du arbeitest Features konzeptionell aus, mit Zielbild, Abläufen und Edge Cases, bevor daraus Tickets werden.

 Du bewertest Lösungsvarianten gemeinsam mit den Entwickler:innen nach Nutzen, Aufwand und Risiko.

 Du sprichst gemeinsam mit Customer Success und Sales mit Kund:innen und prüfst Konzepte mit ihnen, bevor wir sie umsetzen.

 Planung und Steuerung
 Du bereitest die Quartalsplanung mit dem Head of Tech vor und findest die Balance zwischen Kapazitäten und Deadlines.

 Du moderierst Refinements, übernimmst nach der Einarbeitung die Moderation unserer Team-Weeklies, behältst Action Items im Blick und entwickelst die Produktkoordination und die zugehörigen Abläufe weiter.

 Du hältst die Boards aktuell, erkennst Blocker früh und eskalierst sie an die richtige Person.

 Schnittstellen
 Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Sales, CS und QA bei Fragen zu Status und Priorität.

 Du hältst Sales und Customer Success proaktiv auf dem Laufenden, wo ein Release steht und was sich verschiebt.

 Du steuerst, was in Benutzerhandbuch und Kundendokumentation landet.

 Du koordinierst unsere externen App-Entwickler:innen auf Ticketebene.

 Du lieferst die Inhalte für Release Notes und Team Testing.

 Deine ersten Monate
 In den ersten Wochen lernst du Team, Produkt und Kunden kennen und übernimmst Backlog und Tickets der Teams Schritt für Schritt.

 Danach moderierst du Refinements und Weeklies und baust mit uns einen Planungsrhythmus auf, der Fortschritt messbar macht.

 Nach etwa drei Monaten läuft die operative Produktarbeit über dich, und Sales und Customer Success wissen jederzeit, wo ein Release steht.

 Das bringst du mit
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager:in oder technische:r Projektmanager:in in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise in einem B2B-SaaS- oder Startup-Umfeld.

 Sicherer Umgang mit agilen Methoden sowie Erfahrung in Backlog-Management, Priorisierung, Sprint- und Releaseplanung und der Moderation agiler Meetings.

 Du schreibst Tickets, die Entwickler:innen gerne umsetzen: klar, vollständig, mit sauberen Akzeptanzkriterien.

 Genug technisches Verständnis, um Aufwände und Lösungsvorschläge zu hinterfragen, gerne mit Erfahrung in Web- und Mobile-Produkten.

 Erfahrung mit Ticketingsystemen wie GitHub Projects, Jira oder vergleichbaren Tools.

 Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise in einem Remote-Team und klare Kommunikation zwischen Tech und Business.

 Qualitätsanspruch: Du nimmst lieber früh Scope raus, als kurzfristig ein Release verschieben zu müssen.

 Aktive Nutzung von AI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag, zum Beispiel für Ticket-Entwürfe, Analysen und Dokumentation.

 Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse, unsere technische Dokumentation ist auf Englisch.

Principal Product Manager (AI Product) - Join Our Innovative Team at thinkcell Software 

Our Story 

At thinkcell, we create powerful software solutions that help professionals be more efficient and productive. Founded in 2002 and based in Berlin, our tools integrate seamlessly with Microsoft Office to help users create presentations, charts, and diagrams with ease. Our dynamic, international team values creativity, collaboration, and technical excellence.

You'll co-own our AI product end-to-end, from discovery to business outcome. You'll set directions to product managers who each own parts of the product, while staying close to customers and internal stakeholders. With designers and engineers, you'll make sure we build the right things and build them well. This is a pivotal role to help execute an ambitious vision. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Co-own the product 

  • Co-own our AI product end-to-end, from market research and discovery through to UAT and release together with product design and engineering
  • Translate user needs into relevant business outcomes, not just features and products
  • Contribute to product vision, strategy and roadmap in close partnership with leadership 

Teaming 

  • Foster an empowered team across product, design and engineering to deliver great outcomes
  • Set direction for and coach other product managers who own parts of the product

jobs.title: (Stage) Assistant Project Manager Hackathons & Innovation - F/H
jobs.description:
(Stage) Assistant Project Manager Hackathons & Innovation - F/H

  • Stage fin d'études (6 mois)
  • Début : Janiver 2027
  • Lieu : Paris 9e

📌Qui sommes-nous ?

Chez Artefact Adopt AI, nous propulsons l’innovation à travers des événements d’envergure : Ateliers d'innovation participative, Programmes d'intrapreneuriat, et notre format phare : des Hackathons.

Notre mission ? Connecter et faire collaborer un écosystème d'acteurs clés — étudiants, experts Tech et métiers, décideurs, startups, chercheurs — autour des technologies actuelles et de demain : IA, Robotique, Quantique…

En tant qu’Assistant Project Manager, tu co-pilotes ces programmes immersifs de A à Z pour faire émerger des prototypes et solutions, répondant à des problématiques réelles d’aujourd’hui et du futur.

 🚀 Tes défis au quotidien

  1. Gestion et suivi de projet : Tu participes à la création et au suivi des supports de pilotage, ainsi qu’à la gestion des jalons clés de nos expériences.
  2. Coordination : Tu assures une communication et une coordination fluides entre tous les acteurs du projet.
  3. Sourcing & Animation digitale : Tu pilotes le recrutement des participants, le ciblage des experts (mentors, jurys) et l'animation de nos plateformes en ligne.
  4. Orchestration J-J : Tu gères la logistique des temps forts et participes activement à la facilitation, animation et à la coordination générale le Jour-J.
  5. Production de Livrables : Tu conçois les supports de communication (slides, briefs, kits) et structures les synthèses post-événements pour valoriser nos réalisations.

🤖 Ta mission bonus : AI Playground. Tu testes et intègres des solutions IA/tech pour booster nos propres process et enrichir l'expérience des participants.

👤 Ton profil

  • Parcours : Fin d'études (Master 2) en École de commerce, Ingénieur, Université, IEP, Master Innovation, Management, Gestion de Projet.
  • Mindset : Tu as une vraie rigueur d'organisation, excellent relationnel, autonomie et force de proposition. Tu as une appétence forte pour l'innovation, l'écosystème Tech/IA, la gestion d'événements.
  • Outils : Tu sais opérer Canva, des outils visuels (Klaxoon/Mural), Lemlist et tu joues souvent avec des outils d'IA Générative (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini etc.).
  • Langues : Français et Anglais courants (contexte international).

🎁 Ce que nous t'offrons

  • Immersion : Le meilleur spot pour comprendre concrètement les enjeux et usages de l'IA, la Tech et l’innovation de rupture aujourd'hui.Réseau unique : Tu seras en contact direct des acteurs clé étatiques, de la tech, des startups, des écoles et de l'industrie.
  • Un cadre de travail stimulant au sein d'une équipe à taille humaine, dynamique, bienveillante et responsabilisante.</

jobs.title: Product Manager - Agent Experience (Fluency in French & English required)
jobs.description:
Product Manager - Agent Experience 

Location: Paris, France preferred, open to London applicants (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Team: Customer care
Salary: €46,000 – €55,000 / £47,000 – £59,000
Language: Fluency in French & English
Contract: Permanent 
Reporting To: Lead Product Manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

  • Own the Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end strategy for Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE) within the European market—grounded in global product goals but sharpened by local client needs and agent behaviors. Driving core operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, AI adoption, onboarding)ensuring capabilities improve agent/customer outcomes.
  • Drive Journey Design & UX Consistency: Act as guardian of agent UX across KAE to ensure coherence across the experience. Partnering with UX and domain teams to apply shared patterns consistently, reduce agent cognitive load, and maintain alignment and compliance with the design system as new automation and assistive/AI capabilities are introduced.
  • Lead Integrations & Client Onboarding: Drive technical and product integrations with third-party platforms and oversee spinning up new KAE instances end-to-end for incoming clients from discovery through go-live.
  • Ensure Accessibility & Compliance: Champion EU accessibility regulations by design, translating regulatory and market-specific needs into actionable engineering requirements.
  • Engage Clients & Drive Value: Serve as the trusted expert for clients on agent experience, advocating for platform-first configuration over bespoke builds
  • Hands-on Delivery & Enablement: Maintain active involvement across the entire Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC)—from agent discovery sessions to feedback loops—and produce materials to support successful client adoption.

    (Note: Travel to client sites e.g., Brussels, is expected at roughly 1–3 trips a month initially, tapering to 1–2 times a quarter.)

What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Contact Centre & UX Expertise: Deep experience owning end-to-end user journeys for high-frequency operational tools (e.g., agent desktops), with hands-on craft in user research, journey mapping, and usability testing with agents and supervisors.
  • EU Accessibility & Platform Integration: Strong working knowledge of EU accessibility standards alongside proven experience integrating products with complex third-party platforms and vendor ecosystems.
  • Client Delivery & Market Expansion: Successful track record implementing or localizing a product for external enterprise clients, taking solutions from zero to live through discovery, configuration, and change management.
  • Data-Informed Judgement & Influence: Demonstrated ability using operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, agent effort) to defend product decisions, coupled with a platform-first mindset that prioritizes existing capabilities over custom code.
  • Bilingual Capability: Full professional bilingual fluency (written and spoken) in both English and French.

What will set you apart 

  • Experience leveraging AI tools, machine learning capabilities, or LLM integrations within product workflows to enhance platform intelligence and automation directly into customer service desktop envir

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner Clinical Registries
jobs.description:
Our mission 
 We turn data into better healthcare. With our insights, we make healthcare more affordable and better, and we improve the patients’ and clinicians’ experience.
 
 Our mission 
 We turn data into better healthcare. With our insights, we make healthcare more affordable and better, and we improve the patients' and clinicians' experience.
 
 Your impact 
 Dutch clinical registries are among the richest sources of outcome data in Europe. At LOGEX, that data reaches clinicians and hospitals through applications such as Codman and Data Entry, and reaches researchers and healthcare professionals through data requests and exports. As Senior Product Owner you own that portfolio end to end: the applications that clinicians use every day, and the data pipelines that power them.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

 Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

 Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

 What You'll Be Doing 

 You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

 Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

 
 Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.

 Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.

 Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.

 Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

 
 What You'll Need to Thrive 

 Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

 
 Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.

 You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.

 You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.

 You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.

 You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.

 You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.

 You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).

 You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

 
 Next steps

 The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

 
 Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

 If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

 If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

 
Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness .

jobs.title: Product Manager - Products & Pricing
jobs.description:
Product Manager - Products and Pricing

Location: London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Salary: £50,000 – £60,000
Team: Energy Commerce
Contract: Permanent 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the localisation efforts for our products and pricing capabilities, ensuring they meet the specific commercial, regulatory, market, and cultural requirements of retailers in Europe.  This will include European localisations such as indexation and unbundled energy products as well as broader market promotions and discounts.
  • Deep dive into European energy market structures and regulations for designated countries, translating complex needs into detailed product specifications.  Understand the broader context of piercing and selling products in Europe and the required tooling, workflows and models to accelerate our retailers
  • Collaborate intensely with clients and in-country experts to understand their unique needs and requirements. You will be the first point of contact with the client for all domain specific needs.
  • Coordinate cross domain discovery and delivery for features that support key journeys, aligning requirements where needed (eg. billing, quoting and energy insights).
  • Define and manage detailed product requirements for features related to country-specific needs to support energy products and pricing.
  • Contribute to the Global Energy Commerce roadmap, when new acceleration opportunities are identified.
  • Work closely with engineering, UX, and QA teams to ensure the successful implementation and testing of localised billing functionalities.
  • Act as the go-to expert for global teams on specific European market nuances related to energy products and pricing and related customer journeys.

    (Note: Travel to client sites e.g., Brussels, is expected at roughly 1–3 trips a month initially, tapering to 1–2 times a quarter.)

What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager with a strong track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets.
  • Able to establish and maintain great relationships with B2B clients, throughout the entire product lifecycle.
  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end energy lifecycle within a European context, with a particular focus on retailer commercial operations.
  • Direct experience with specific European energy markets, understanding their unique regulatory frameworks and requirements
  • Exceptional ability to translate abstract regulatory text or client requirements into clear, actionable requirements for development teams.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, legal, operations, client success) to deliver localised solutions.
  • Experience working alongside multiple services/domains to deliver complex journeys.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to articulate technical and market complexities to various stakeholders, including clients.

What will set you apart 

  • Deep, hands-on experience with the French or Belgian energy retail markets, particularly concerning their energy products and pricing s

jobs.title: Product Manager - Field Service Management (SaaS)
jobs.description:
The Joblogic Story

Established in 1998, Joblogic is the UK’s #1 Field Service Management (FSM) software platform. We are a global business with offices in the UK, Pakistan, and Vietnam. Since our management buy-out in 2013, we have grown from ~£500K ARR to ~£35M+ ARR and expanded our team from 11 to 500+ people.

Recently, we secured a strategic growth investment from Vista Equity Partners — a global technology investor specialising in enterprise software. This investment includes over £100 million in new primary capital and will fuel our next phase of growth by accelerating our AI-first roadmap, expanding our platform into CAFM (Computer-Aided Facilities Management) capabilities, and supporting our expansion across Europe and beyond.

With Vista’s backing, we’re transforming from a successful UK business into a global scaling SaaS rocket ship, and we’d love for you to join us on our journey to £100M ARR across international markets.

Joblogic provides software to service contractors who install and maintain the built environment. Our platform helps businesses streamline operations, improve profitability, ensure compliance, and achieve rapid growth. With over 100,000 users across industries including HVAC, plumbing, electrical maintenance, facilities management, and building fabric maintenance, we are entering a new era of intelligent automation, predictive maintenance, and data-driven decision-making for service firms.

 

About the role

We are looking for a Product Manager with strong experience in Field Service Management (FSM), Facility Management, or operational workflow-driven SaaS products.

As a Product Manager at Joblogic, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our platform by deeply understanding how service contractors operate and translating complex operational workflows into intuitive product solutions.

You will work closely with engineering, UX, customer-facing teams, and customers themselves to identify real-world operational challenges and build solutions that simplify the daily work of engineers, planners, helpdesk teams, and operations managers.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving real operational problems, working closely with users, and building workflow-driven B2B SaaS products.

What your main focus will be

Lead discovery with customers across field service and facilities management operations.

Understand and map operational workflows including:

  • Reactive maintenance jobs
  • Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM)
  • Scheduling and dispatch
  • Field engineer mobile workflows
  • Asset lifecycle management
  • Quote → job → invoicing journeys

You will be expected to:

  1. Translate complex operational problems into clear product requirements and solution design.
  2. Work closely with UX designers to create intuitive workflows and product experiences.
  3. Define and prioritise roadmap initiatives aligned with product strategy and customer value.
  4. Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and deliver real operational impact.
  5. Validate product ideas through customer interviews, field research, and prototype testing.
  6. Monitor product adoption, workflow performance, and user behaviour to continuously improve features.
  7. Partner with internal teams including Sales, Customer Success, and Support to ensure successful feature adoption.

What you bring

  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager within B2B SaaS environments.
  • Strong understanding of Field Service Management, Facilities Management, or operational workflow-based software.
  • Experience translating real-world operational processes into clear product logic and requirements.
  • Strong discovery skills and ability to conduct customer interviews and uncover real problems.
  • Experience collaborating closely with UX designers and engineering teams.
  • Strong ability to manage stakeholders and communicate product strategy clearly.
  • Structured thinking and ability to break down complex workflows into scalable product solutions.
  • Comfortable working in fast-moving product environments with multiple priorities and cross-functional teams.
