jobs.title: Senior Product Owner - Social Connection & Loyalty
jobs.description:
Our Team 
 We believe travel can create citizens of the world. We spark moments of connection and transformation, giving people the freedom to explore openly and shape their own story.
 
 With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight, and a culture of openness, essential to understanding our travellers and one another.
 
 We work in a flexible hybrid model from our Utrecht HQ and our homes across the Netherlands.
 
 Just as travel is about discovery, we’re looking for people who want to go one stop further, joining a journey that inspires personal transformation through train travel.
 
 We’re on the search for… 
 At Interrail, we help people experience Europe by train. We are looking for a PO to make that experience more connected, rewarding, and transformative. You will lead the strategy and roadmap for products that bring travellers together, recognise their journeys, and give them more reasons to return to Interrail and make them feel a sense of belonging. 
 
 From social connection, community, to loyalty, referrals, and gamification, you will create experiences that turn a great trip into a lasting relationship with our brand. Some of these experiences will also support informal learning, intercultural exchange and personal development through travel.
 
 You will work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, Lifecycle Marketing, Customer Experience, and Commercial teams to build products that customers genuinely value and that strengthen engagement, retention, advocacy, and lifetime value. 
 The role exists to solve one fundamental challenge: how do we create meaningful reasons for travellers to remain engaged with Interrail between journeys, and return not only to travel again, but to participate, contribute and advocate for the brand?
 
 What you’ll be doing 
 Define and deliver the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for community, loyalty, referrals, and gamification. 

 Own the digital loyalty experience and economics. 

 Design products that enable meaningful interactions and real-world connections between travellers, while maintaining a safe, respectful and inclusive environment. 

 Develop product experiences that encourage cultural exchange, curiosity and informal learning through social interaction. 

 Work with Institutional Initiatives to translate relevant programme objectives into engaging traveller experiences, where these align with the broader Social Connection & Loyalty product strategy. 

 Build experiences that help travellers connect, share, contribute, and discover useful travel content. 

 Create loyalty, recognition, and referral journeys that encourage advocacy and repeat travel. 

 Work with Design, CX, and Engineering to deliver simple, scalable web and mobile experiences. 

 Partner with Lifecycle Marketing to connect campaigns with relevant in-product journeys. 

 Use customer insight, behavioural data, AI, and experimentation (A/B testing) to identify opportunities and personalise experiences. 

 Work with Customer Support and relevant partners to ensure community experiences are safe, trustworthy, and useful. 

 Define and track success metrics across Traveller Participation Rate, engagement, retention, repeat purchase, referrals, loyalty participation, and customer lifetime value. 

 
 What we’re looking for 
 It's already a possible match when you share the same mindset as us, being forward-thinking, results-driven, caring and embracing diversity.
 
 In terms of your experience and skills:
 8+ years of product management experience, with experience building and scaling B2C digital products across web and mobile.

 A track record of building products that improve engagement, retention, loyalty, community participation, or growth. 

 Demonstrated experience building social, community-driven or interaction-led digital products, with a strong understanding of how to create meaningful interactions between users. 

 Experience owning a product area from strategy and discovery through delivery, scaling, and optimization. 

 Experience designing for trust, safety, inclusion and healthy community participation, particularly where digital experiences facilitate interaction between people who do not already know one another. 

 Strong qualitative user research and behavioral insight skills, with the ability to understand why people connect, participate and contribute, not only what they click or use. 

 Strong product judgment and the ability to turn customer insight into simple, valuable experiences. 

 Confidence using data, experimentation, and product metrics to make decisions and measure incremental impact. 

 Experience working closely with Design, Engineering, Data, Marketing, and other business stakeholders. 

 A thoughtful approach to customer trust, privacy, safety, and responsible engagement design. 

 Comfort working in a fast-moving, international environment.

Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.
 Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.
 Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.
 
 
 ⚡ Notre équipe Customer Operations 
 L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service.

Tu seras le point de repère côté Lifen pour structurer le projet, donner de la visibilité aux clients et lever les obstacles avec les équipes internes.

 Cartographier les établissements, les services concernés et leurs besoins pour cadrer chaque déploiement.

 Construire le planning projet, poser les jalons et suivre leur avancement.

 Animer les réunions de suivi et formaliser les décisions.

 Coordonner Business Development, Customer Operations, Ops Manager et R&D.

 Suivre les usages après le déploiement et identifier les difficultés rencontrées sur le terrain.

 Centraliser les bugs et demandes d’évolution, puis communiquer sur les corrections et nouveautés.

 Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe.

 
 
 ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons 
 Must-have
 Une solide expérience dans la gestion de projets, idéalement dans le déploiement de logiciels ou de solutions numériques.

 Une bonne connaissance fonctionnelle et technique du secteur de la santé et de l’organisation d’un établissement de santé.

 Des bases en interopérabilité, en flux de données et en FHIR.

 La capacité à cadrer en autonomie des projets simples, suivre un calendrier, identifier les blocages et solliciter son manager lorsque nécessaire.

 Une communication écrite et orale claire auprès de clients comme d’équipes internes.

 Nice-to-have
 Une expérience auprès de grands comptes hospitaliers ou de groupements d’établissements de santé.

 Une connaissance des enjeux techniques liés à l’architecture d’une plateforme logicielle et aux intégrations entre systèmes.

 L’habitude de former des utilisateurs sur des outils ou processus fonctionnels.

 Une bonne maîtrise de Notion, des outils Google ou Office et d’outils de suivi de projet.

 Soft skills
 Tu sais organiser ton travail sans attendre qu’on te donne chaque prochaine étape, tout en signalant rapidement les risques ou les dépendances. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement concret d’un client avant de proposer une solution. Face à des interlocuteurs aux priorités différentes, tu gardes le cap, tu reformules et tu fais avancer les décisions.
 
 
 Nos valeurs
 Embrace Complexity : tu prends le temps de comprendre les contraintes d’un établissement, les dépendances techniques et les besoins des utilisateurs.
 Bienveillance : tu communiques avec clarté, écoutes les difficultés et cherches des solutions avec les parties prenantes.
 Real Impact : tu veilles à ce que les solutions déployées soient réellement utilisées et facilitent le travail des professionnels de santé.

 Entretien avec Loïc, Hiring Manager - 45 min. Une première rencontre avec ton potentiel futur manager qui approfondira ton expérience de gestion de projet et de déploiement, ta compréhension des environnements de santé et ta connaissance fonctionnelle des produits déployés.

jobs.title: English to German (Switzerland) Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content
jobs.description:
About Welo Global 

 Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com 

 

 
 
 The Role 

 
 We are seeking an experienced English into German (Switzerland) Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client. 

 
 You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content. 

 
 Project Details 
 

 - Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
 - Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
 - Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
 - Task type: Language Lead Support
 - Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
 - Language pair: English into German from Switzerland 

 
 What You Will Do 

 -Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
 -Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
 -Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
 -Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
 -Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time. 

 What You Will Own 

 -The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality 
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking 
 

 
 
 Requirements 

 - Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles 
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution 
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping 
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI) 
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting 
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements 
- Language: Native-level German (Switzerland) and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior e xperience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools

 
 Additional Key Information

- A background check is required as part of onboarding.

jobs.title: Product Lead 100%
jobs.description:
Unsere Mission 
 Photovoltaik wirtschaftlich, einfach und sorglos machen. Wir bringen die Energiewende ins Gebäude – mit intelligenten Lösungen für Eigenverbrauch & Elektromobilität, die sich für alle lohnen: Investor:innen, Nutzer:innen und unsere Zukunft.
 Als ZEV-Pionierin ist Smart Energy Link heute die führende Schweizer B2B-Plattform für Abrechnung und intelligente Steuerung dezentraler Energieinfrastruktur. Mit einem Team von rund 35 Mitarbeitenden haben wir bereits über 700 Projekte erfolgreich realisiert und betreuen mehr als 20'000 Wohneinheiten im Bereich ZEV und Metering.
 Deine Rolle 
 SEL wächst vom Start-up zum Scale-up – und du gestaltest unsere Produkte in dieser Phase aktiv mit. Als Product Lead verantwortest du unsere Webportale inklusive der Abrechnungslösung und treibst die Produktstrategie gemeinsam mit dem CEO, dem UX-Team und der Entwicklung voran. Du denkst strategisch, führst die Product Discovery und packst bei der Umsetzung mit an – kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheide, echter Gestaltungsspielraum.
 Du verantwortest den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg deiner Produkte, inklusive Preisgestaltung und Markteinführung.

 Du übersetzt Kunden- und Marktbedürfnisse in eine klare Produkt-Roadmap – im Rahmen der regulatorischen Vorgaben (ZEV/vZEV/LEG).

 Du entwickelst unsere Webportale zu einer skalierbaren Plattform weiter und verantwortest die Produkt-Vision, -Strategie und -Roadmap.

 Du sorgst für die marktgerechte Weiterentwicklung der Abrechnungslösung.

 Das bringst du mit 
 Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-SaaS-Plattformen, mit agilen Entwicklungsmethoden und in der Skalierung. Technische Konzepte verstehst du so gut, dass du mit der Entwicklung auf Augenhöhe diskutieren kannst.

 Du bringst Erfahrung in Abrechnungs- und Inkassoprozessen mit, idealerweise in einem ZEV- (vZEV, LEG) Umfeld.

 Du kennst die Stromtarifmodelle im europäischen Raum und die regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen der Schweiz (Energiewirtschaft).

 Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und nutzt beide Sprachen im Alltag

 Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und teamorientiert

 Du hast eine hohe KI-Affinität.

 Schön, aber kein Muss: 
 Erfahrung mit Elektromobilität oder Smart Grid · Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung interdisziplinärer Teams · technischer Studienabschluss (z. B. Informatik, Elektro-/Energietechnik) oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.
 Was wir bieten: 
 Bei SEL arbeitest du an etwas, das zählt: Du prägst die Zukunft des Schweizer Energiesektors mit – Tag für Tag.
 Bring dich ein und gestalte die Firma aktiv mit - inkl. Mitarbeiterbeteiligung.

 Wir fördern dein Lernen & Wachstum und beteiligen uns an Kursen, Aus- und Weiterbildungen.

 Wir leben Flexibilität: Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag weitgehend selbst 

 Wir arbeiten mit Jahresarbeitszeit und einer 40-Stunden-Woche.

 plus: NIKIN-Hoodie, Füürabe-Aareschwumm und Glace im Gfrüürfach

 Wir sind ein agiles Team, das sich gegenseitig schätzt, fordert und weiterbringt – offen, direkt und auf Augenhöhe. Wenn du Lust hast, wirklich etwas zu bewegen: Werde Energiepionier:in bei SEL.
 So geht's weiter 
 Bewirb dich direkt – wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage bei dir. Unser Prozess: ein kurzes Kennenlerngespräch per Telefon oder Video, ein ausführliches Interview vor Ort oder remote und ein Schnuppertag, an dem du unser Team und unsere Arbeitsweise hautnah erlebst. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören.

jobs.description:
OUR MISSION 
 We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.
 Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country.  As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help our care team focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.
 Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

You will establish the product foundation across workflow tooling, data integrations, and AI systems, while creating patterns that can scale across future products and initiatives. Much of this work sits at the intersection of applied AI, clinical guidelines, and operational workflows in a regulated setting where fidelity, auditability, and trust are non-negotiable. This is an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a product team over time as this business line grows.

 Drive the roadmap for a zero-to-one AI initiative to improve care decisions in oncology

 Leverage AI to accelerate your own work and help decide how the team uses AI tooling to move faster and prototype more efficiently

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager Heating & Cooling (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

 At 1KOMMA5° , we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it? 

 We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia. 

 Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow. 

 Learn about our Product & Tech team!

 Your mission

 As Senior Product Manager for Heating & Cooling, you own Heat as a product. What must be true in the household: space heating, hot water, and cooling people can trust, at a cost that makes sense, controlled with Heartbeat. 

 You decide where Heating & Cooling goes next. Which problems we solve first. How hardware partners, the Energy Management System, and the customer experience add up to one result — in Germany and in the other markets we operate in. You own the problem, the requirements, and the outcomes. 

 Your main focus will be to:

 
 Own the product strategy and roadmap for Heating & Cooling: where the area goes, and how it evolves across markets

 Define the customer outcome (comfort, cost, control, reliability) and the KPIs that prove it

 Turn hardware and field constraints into product requirements. Cut work that does not serve the outcome.

 Drive thermal optimization on our Energy Management System

 Align hardware, the Energy Management System, and the customer experience so households get one heat and cooling experience

 Write specs, run discovery, prioritize, and ship

 
 Your profile

 You have: 

 
 5+ years of Product Management on hardware-software products, energy, HVAC, or similarly physical systems

 A track record of owning a customer outcome across more than one engineering team

 Comfort at the seam of OEM interfaces, optimization, and customer UX

 Excellent English and German

 Based in Germany or willing to relocate

 
 Bonus points for:

 
 Heat pumps, SG Ready, EEBus, Modbus, OEM cloud APIs

 Field or installer experience

 Thermal optimization or HEMS with heat pumps

 Heating and cooling products across more than one country

 
 Benefits

 
 You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen

 With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate

 Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues

 You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers

 You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups

 You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich

 Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass

 Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens

 Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

jobs.title: Senior Hardware Project Manager (All genders)
jobs.description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

You will join our cross-functional hardware engineering group focused on delivering next-generation autonomous defence platforms. Our team collaborates closely across mechanical, electrical, and systems engineering to bring complex hardware projects from initial design to field readiness. We value agile execution, rigorous technical standards, and open communication in a fast-paced environment.

YOUR MISSION

As Senior Hardware Project Manager, you will oversee the full lifecycle of complex hardware engineering projects for next-generation autonomous defence systems. You will lead cross-functional engineering teams, manage hardware supply chains, and align project milestones with company strategic goals to deliver field-tested, mission-critical hardware solutions.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Coordinate multi-disciplinary teams including electrical, mechanical, embedded software, and quality engineers.
  • Define project schedules, resource allocations, risk mitigation plans, and budget tracking.
  • Manage key external suppliers, manufacturing partners, and component procurement processes.
  • Ensure hardware compliance with industry and defence qualification standards and safety regulations.
  • Facilitate design reviews, milestone gates, and technical reporting for internal leadership and external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager Growth (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Trusted Shops creates digital trust between people, businesses, and AI Agents. Every day, millions of consumers rely on our solutions to make confident online decisions, while businesses use our products to build trust, strengthen customer relationships, and grow sustainably. With around 700 colleagues across Europe, more than 25,000 online shops, and over 40 million consumers in our Community of Trust, we are helping shape a safer and more transparent digital world. 
 
 To join our Consumer Membership Team, we are looking for a:
 Senior Product Manager Growth (f/m/d) 
 Cologne (hybrid) or Berlin (remote) | Permanent Contract (Full-time)
 
 to identify, validate, and scale opportunities that drive sustainable growth for our consumer business and create meaningful value for our consumers.
 In this role, you will own important parts of our growth agenda end to end. You will uncover opportunities across the consumer journey, turn insights into hypotheses, rapidly test them, and scale the approaches that demonstrate impact.
 This is a highly cross-functional role at the intersection of product, customer experience, data, technology, marketing, and commercial strategy . You will work with a dedicated product team as well as partners across the organization to turn growth opportunities into measurable outcomes.
 
 What you'll do 
 Own growth outcomes, not just features. Define ambitious goals and translate them into a focused product and experimentation strategy with clear, measurable KPIs.

 Identify growth opportunities. Use quantitative data, customer insights, market trends, and experimentation to uncover opportunities across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, conversion, and monetization.

 Build and prioritize a growth roadmap. Decide where the biggest opportunities lie and balance quick experiments with larger strategic bets.

 Experiment systematically. Develop hypotheses, design experiments, evaluate results, and use learnings to determine what to iterate, scale, or stop.

 Turn successful experiments into scalable products. Go beyond optimization and ensure that validated ideas become sustainable capabilities and customer experiences.

 Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, and Commercial teams to move from opportunity to execution while keeping teams aligned around outcomes.

Team

Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK.

Role Summary

PLOS is a nonprofit Open Access publisher with an ambitious mission: to help transform research communication so that science can be shared, understood and used more effectively. 

Research publishing is changing rapidly. Researchers' expectations are changing. Technology is creating possibilities that didn't exist a few years ago. And at PLOS we're rethinking some of the services, systems and assumptions that have shaped scholarly publishing for decades. 

That means there are interesting product problems to solve - not just features to deliver. 

You'll take responsibility for a product area and work with designers, engineers and colleagues across PLOS to understand the problems that matter, work out where we can make the greatest difference and help the team learn its way towards good solutions. 

You'll be joining active product teams working on significant problems and will have plenty of opportunity to shape what we do and how we do it. 

 

How we work 

We want our product teams to be curious, evidence-led and comfortable with uncertainty. 

We don't expect a Product Manager to arrive with all the answers. We do expect them to ask good questions. 

You'll use continuous discovery alongside delivery: spending time with users, looking at data, understanding the wider service, identifying assumptions and finding practical ways to test them. 

You'll help the team break large problems into smaller things we can learn from, rather than waiting until everything is known before we release something. 

And you'll make the team's thinking visible - explaining what we're trying to achieve, what we've learned, what we're uncertain about and why we're making the choices we are. 

 

Responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll: 

  • Understand the problem. Build a deep understanding of our users, their needs and behaviours, as well as the organisational, operational and technical context surrounding them. 
  • Shape product direction. Work out where the greatest opportunities lie within your area and help translate PLOS's objectives into clear product outcomes and priorities. 
  • Practise continuous discovery. Work closely with design, engineering and others to explore problems, identify assumptions and regularly test ideas with users and through data.

 Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.

 Own the peptide/product product roadmap end to end, agreeing priorities with model, data and science teams and holding the line on scope.

 Define packaging and commercial models for each offering, including access arrangements, bespoke model fine-tuning on partner data, co-development structures and asset-level licensing.

You'll join as we prove out the book, then take it into its next phase of growth. This suits someone who wants to shape a product while it's still being defined, not inherit a finished one.

Like most teams at Lendable, it's small relative to what it runs, so you'll own decisions and their implementation rather than handing them off. The work sits close to the proprietary AI and decisioning that lets us see people as individuals rather than credit scores. You'll be expected to use AI to build, test and analyse faster than a team our size otherwise could.

 Owning the product vision and roadmap : first to market parity, then past it, for our current and expanding target segment, driven by customer understanding and experimentation.

 What we're looking for

 A track record of owning product outcomes end to end. You make tough calls under ambiguity, own them, and course-correct when the evidence turns.

 Strong analytical instinct:

 a feel for what the numbers should look like

 the instinct to notice when something is off

 the persistence to find the real driver, without taking a confident answer from a dashboard or model at face value

 Comfort working hands-on: writing and resolving tickets, prototyping, and making implementation and design decisions yourself.

 Real fluency with AI tools as a working part of how you build, test and analyse.

 The ability to lead through influence across Credit, Growth, Design, Data Science and Compliance. You change your mind when presented with a good argument, and you expect others to do the same.

 Nice to have 
 Experience with consumer credit lifecycle levers such as credit line management, pricing, and retention and reactivation.

 Experience shaping mobile app journeys for activation and engagement.

 A quick chat with someone from our Talent team to see if the role is a good match.

 A 15-minute cognitive assessment .

 An interview with the Hiring Manager , covering your experience and how you approach the work.

 A practical exercise or case study relevant to the role, discussed with the team you'd be working with.

 A set of final interviews to assess how you'd thrive within our team and organisation.

 Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days

jobs.title: Product Owner - Mobile Integrations (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime , we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually
 Creating solutions that run on 13% of the world’s smartphones 
 The Mobile Integrations team builds the core technology that turns advertising from an interruption into a rewarded experience for 770 million users. We own the robust, lightweight, integration layer between our ad engine and the global mobile ecosystem, ensuring our technology operates with minimal overhead while reaching a massive portion of the smartphone market.
 On the client side, our technology performs smoothly across 20 million daily SDK initializations. We build native Swift and Kotlin SDKs optimized for ms initialization and minimal binary overhead, with Unity, Flutter, and React Native wrappers that provide a unified API across the entire mobile ecosystem. Behind the scenes, a high-throughput Go and DynamoDB architecture handles the real-time state synchronization of millions of concurrent sessions. When your code runs on nearly one out of every seven smartphones on Earth, every millisecond of execution and every byte of memory counts.
 What you Will Do: 
 Own and prioritize the Mobile SDK product backlog, balancing customer needs, business priorities, technical requirements, and engineering capacity.

 Translate product and developer needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable priorities for the engineering team.

 Drive feature delivery from discovery and planning through development, testing, release, and post-launch evaluation.

 Work closely with Android, iOS, Backend, QA, and other stakeholders to manage dependencies, resolve blockers, and ensure smooth delivery.

 Gather and analyze feedback from customers, developers, and internal teams to identify integration pain points and opportunities to improve the SDK and developer experience.

 Support SDK releases and rollouts, including release planning, documentation, adoption tracking, and communication with relevant stakeholders.

 Use product data, SDK telemetry, and feedback to measure outcomes, identify opportunities, and continuously improve the Mobile SDK platform.

 Who You Are: 
 You bring 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Product Owner in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. (Bonus points if you have a background in ad-tech or Mobile/SDKs) 

 You aren't expected to write code, but you are right at home discussing SDK architecture. You grasp the fundamentals and differences between iOS and Android, empowering you to have meaningful debates with the development team and properly weigh technical debt against business value.

 You have a proven track record of leveraging A/B testing and experimentation to drive product strategy. You know exactly how to define clear success metrics, analyze KPIs, and confidently pivot based on what the data tells you.

 You are a digital native who speaks the language of both business and engineering fluidly. You excel at closing the gap, aligning what the business envisions with what the technology can actually execute.

 You take deep ownership of your product. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, working independently, and making the objective calls needed to balance incoming business requests with the long-term technical integrity of the platform.

 You possess concise, direct communication skills. You know how to align, motivate, and guide interdisciplinary teams, cultivating a thriving and collaborative environment even as project requirements evolve.

 What you get: 
 Invest in Your Future: Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skill set and achieve your career goals.

 Easy Arrival to adjoe: From signing to settling in Hamburg, we’ve got you covered. Need a visa? No problem. Ready to build your new life and career at adjoe in Hamburg? We support every ambition—from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you make Hamburg feel like home.

 Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond: We work in a hybrid setup with core office days on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday, plus flexible working hours. Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

 Thrive Where You Work: Enjoy the Alster lake view from our central office with top-notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks.

 Join the Community! Participate in regular team and company events, including hackathons and social gatherings. We work together, and we celebrate together, too.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
As a Senior Product Manager (m/w/d), you will own eCommerce storefront initiatives end to end, from concept and discovery through launch and optimization, with a global scope across PERGOLUX markets. You will define product solutions, scope, and success metrics for content-rich, UX-heavy customer journeys, and you will drive measurable improvements in storefront performance such as add-to-cart and checkout conversion. Working closely with UX, development, analytics, performance marketing, and country teams, you will structure complex product information into clear, attractive pages that reflect a premium brand experience.
 PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. With around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations across 8 markets, we have grown consistently across Europe and beyond, building a collaborative international team along the way.
 What You'll Do 
 • Own eCommerce product initiatives from concept to launch and optimization, defining scope, risks, requirements, and success metrics.
 • Conduct product discovery through user research, competitor analysis, usability testing, and synthesizing customer feedback into product decisions.
 • Create page concepts, wireframes, prototypes, copy drafts, and visual briefs, and write clear specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
 • Plan delivery with development, managing priorities, dependencies, QA, releases, rollout logic, toggles, and rollback plans.
 • Monitor launches and use analytics, A/B testing, and experimentation to drive rapid fixes and follow-up improvements to storefront performance.
 What You'll Bring 
 • 5+ years in product management for eCommerce products, with strong experience in UX-heavy, content-rich customer journeys.
 • Proven ability to structure complex product information into clear, simple, and attractive pages, backed by customer research and insight-driven decisions.
 • Strong visual taste and an understanding of what makes a premium digital brand experience, plus the ability to create concepts, wireframes, and copy drafts independently.
 • Solid command of CRO, analytics, A/B testing, and storefront performance optimization, and a track record of aligning UX, developers, analytics, and marketing.
 • Nice to have: experience with Shopify or other storefront platforms, high-ticket or considered-purchase eCommerce, premium/lifestyle brands, and building repeatable product processes or templates.

 💼 Compensation — Competitive salary that reflects your expertise and rewards results · Company pension plan · Capped overtime, fully paid, with no endless unpaid crunch
 🚀 Growth and Career Development — You will take on real ownership from the start with direct impact on key business outcomes, work alongside an international team across Europe, and follow fast-track opportunities to grow into senior leadership roles as PERGOLUX scales.
 ⏰ Time Off and Flexibility — Up to 30 vacation days, starting at 27 · One week per year remote workation in the EU/UK

 🌟 Benefits and Lifestyle 
 • Team culture with regular team events (summer party, Christmas party, after-work gatherings) and retreats
 • Modern setup and laptops (Apple or Windows)
 • Employee discounts on PERGOLUX products
 • Jobrad / bike leasing program, promoting sustainable and healthy commuting
 📍 Office Location – Schlesische Str. 27 C, Building C, 6th floor, 10997 Berlin, Germany
 How to Apply 
 If this role fits what you are looking for, we would like to hear from you. Apply through our [Career Page]( https://pergolux.careers/ ) and connect with us on [LinkedIn]( https://www.linkedin.com/company/pergolux/posts/?feedView=all ) to learn more about life at PERGOLUX.
 PERGOLUX is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, we think it's less about ticking every box and more about what you bring to the table!

jobs.title: Product Manager - Product Launches
jobs.description:
As Product Manager – Product Launches, you will own the end-to-end execution of new and upgraded product launches across PERGOLUX markets worldwide. You will be responsible for turning product development into successful market launches by ensuring every critical requirement—from supplier readiness and product documentation to inventory, ecommerce setup, training, compliance, and quality gates—is completed before go-live. At PERGOLUX , we are building a premium outdoor-living brand with ambitious global growth, bringing together international teams through a culture of integrity, ambition, innovation, humility, appreciation, and unity.
 What You’ll Do
 Own the end-to-end execution of assigned new product and product-upgrade launches across Europe, the US, Australia, and other PERGOLUX markets, managing launch plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, responsibilities, and go/no-go decisions.

 Coordinate cross-functionally with Product Development, manufacturing suppliers, Supply Chain, Ecommerce, Content, Marketing, Sales, Customer Service, Compliance, and Country Managers to ensure complete launch readiness across markets and time zones.

 Drive operational readiness by ensuring specifications, installation manuals, certifications, compliance documentation, pricing, SKUs, product content, translations, imagery, Shopify setup, inventory, team training, and support materials are accurate, complete, and approved before launch.

 Define and operate clear quality gates and launch-readiness processes, coordinating manufacturer, field, and laboratory testing, identifying risks early, driving solutions, escalating critical issues, and providing clear launch-status reporting to Product leadership and key stakeholders.

 Continuously improve how we launch products by owning installation manual quality, managing SKU phase-outs and product transitions, conducting post-launch retrospectives, maintaining risk logs and rollout trackers, and reducing avoidable rework and post-launch issues.

 What You’ll Bring
 2–4 years of experience in Product Management, Product Operations, Technical Project Management, or a similar execution-focused role, with experience coordinating product launches, new product introductions, or complex cross-functional projects.

 Strong project planning, timeline management, stakeholder coordination, and structured reporting skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple workstreams and maintain momentum toward critical deadlines.

 Confidence working with physical products, technical specifications, installation manuals, specification sheets, and other product documentation, with strong attention to detail and ownership of quality.

 Experience coordinating directly with overseas or offshore manufacturing suppliers and working effectively across departments, cultures, and time zones; experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Excel, Shopify, Zendesk, or Airtable is a plus.

 A proactive, highly accountable mindset: you identify problems early, ask the right questions, follow actions through to completion, make sound day-to-day decisions independently, and know when commercial, compliance, or strategic decisions require escalation.

 Benefits
 Competitive Salary & Bonus Structure – Your success is rewarded with strong compensation and performance-based bonuses.

 Real Ownership – Take meaningful responsibility in your role and directly influence key business outcomes.

 International Team – Collaborate with passionate colleagues across Europe, gaining exposure to diverse perspectives and ideas.

 Outdoor Lifestyle Discounts – Enjoy exclusive discounts on PERGOLUX products.

 Fast-Track Career Opportunities – As we scale quickly, you’ll have significant opportunities to grow into senior leadership roles.

 Team Culture – Be part of regular team events, retreats, and a culture that celebrates wins—big and small.

 Bike Leasing Program – Benefit from a sustainable and cost-effective bike leasing option to support commuting and an active lifestyle.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – JetBrains Air (Agentic Development in IDEs)
jobs.description:
Are you comfortable navigating complex software systems, working with coding agents, and defining what makes developer tools actually useful? Do you want to shape how developers and AI work together inside IDEs?

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

Agentic development is changing how software gets built. Developers no longer just chat with AI – they delegate tasks, run parallel agent sessions, and steer autonomous changes. As agents take on more work, reviewing and owning the output is becoming the hardest part of the process. 

JetBrains Air is our open system for agentic development. It brings tools like Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude Agent, Gemini, and Junie directly into JetBrains IDEs, providing an agentic-first user experience.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead key areas of Air. You’ll take ownership of high-impact workflows, work closely with cross-functional teams (including software engineers, designers, ML researchers, analysts, DevRel, and product marketing), and turn technical complexity into clear product direction.

Day to day, you will:

  • Take end-to-end ownership of key parts of Air in JetBrains IDEs, driving work from problem framing and discovery to delivery, adoption, and iteration.
  • Define and refine core agentic workflows, including task delegation, session monitoring, steering, and code review.
  • Model complex user flows, system states, permissions, and integration schemes to guide engineering and design decisions.
  • Maintain a transparent roadmap that balances quick improvements with long-term strategic investments.
  • Define telemetry, design experiments, analyze product data, and make evidence-based roadmap decisions.
  • Study how developers interact with leading AI agents and tools to inform product priorities.
  • Engage with the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) ecosystem and collaborate with partners building on it.
  • Partner with enterprise sales and support teams to address governance, privacy, and control requirements.

What you’ll bring

  • A systems-thinking mindset that easily breaks down complex architectures, workflows, and dependencies.
  • A data-driven approach to product decisions, including hands-on experience querying and analyzing telemetry.
  • Active personal experience using coding agents and clear perspectives on where current AI tools succeed and fail.
  • Strong product intuition for complex technical user experiences and developer workflows.
  • Clear, concise, and collaborative communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts simply and build alignment across diverse groups of stakeholders.
  • Comfort navigating fast-changing technical landscapes with high ambiguity.

What you’ll need

  • Proven experience shipping end-user products as a product manager or in a similar role.
  • Strong technical grounding in software development workflows, including IDEs, git, code review, CI/CD, and package management.
  • A hands-on technical background sufficient to collaborate closely with software and ML engineers.
  • An understanding of core AI and agent concepts, including tool use, protocols (MCP/ACP), context retrieval, evaluations, and latency/cost trade-offs.
  • The ability to write SQL or Python to analyze product metrics and experiment results independently.
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

What success looks like

In your first 6 to 12 months, success in this role means:

  • Driving measurable growth in active Air users and improving weekly/monthly retention (D7/D30).
  • Increasing agent session completion rates and the proportion of agent-generated changes accepted by developers.
  • Establishing clear, telemetry-backed decisions across your product roadmap areas.
  • Delivering validated product hypotheses consistently each quarter.
  • Contributing directly to JetBrains AI revenue growth and overall IDE value.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
  • Free meals and sna

jobs.title: Product Manager, Agents
jobs.description:
Product Manager, Agents 
 London, 4x days per week in-office
 
 Vega is looking for A-players who will define and build the next generation of Agentic products that will shape the next era of private markets.
 
 About Vega 
 Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.
 
 Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.
 
 Who we are 
 We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.
 
 How we do it 
 Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:
 We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

 We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

 We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

 We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

 We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

 We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.
 
 Who succeeds in this role 
 We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.
 
 In this role, you will:
 Lead and partner with engineering teams on technical concepts to deliver exceptional AI-first solutions. Prototype instead of writing specs.

 Own an agentic surface end-to-end and decide what runs unattended and what needs a human.

 Keep every autonomous action explainable and reversible. Own the tradeoffs on reliability, latency and cost.

 Sit with GP and LP ops teams, find the manual work, remove it without breaking their controls.

 Operate and deliver with a sense of urgency under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment where multi-tasking, strong communication and problem-solving skills are a must.

 
 What we look for: 
 2+ years in product, ideally somewhere where being wrong is expensive.

 Hands-on with prompting, context engineering and evals. You've done it yourself, not managed someone who did.

 You've shipped LLM or agent features to real users, and can say what broke.

 Enough technical fluency to argue with engineers about retrieval and tool design. Good judgement to know when AI is the wrong answer.

 Working with GPs/LPs and/or knowledge of Fund administration, KYC/AML or LP portals is an advantage.

 
 Why join us? 
 You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team

 Competitive salary and equity package

 Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

jobs.title: Team Lead Manager - Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Our Mission:
 Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.
 Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.
 Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.
 Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.
 
 Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here .
 
 What We’re Looking For

 We’re looking for highly technical engineers who want to lead and manage one of our engineering teams. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans, and we’re now growing from 11 to more than 14 engineering teams in the coming months. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~180 to 300+, and revenue will triple.
  
 As a Team Lead Manager, you’ll lead a small team of engineers. You’ll set its technical direction, line-manage and grow the people in it, and stay hands-on in the code. This is not a hands-off management role: our teams are small, and you’ll be one of the strongest engineers on yours. You’ll partner closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer to decide what to build, and you’ll be accountable for how well it’s built and how fast it ships.
  
 If you’re a strong Tech Lead who hasn’t managed people yet, we’d still love to hear from you. You can start as a Team Lead, with management handled by an Engineering Manager, and grow into the full role with our support.
  
 What Can You Expect As a Team Lead Manager?

 Lead and Manage a Small Team. Line-manage the engineers on your team, run 1:1s, give feedback, and help them take on bigger problems.

 Stay Deeply Technical. You’ll still build. Expect to spend a meaningful share of your time writing code, reviewing PRs, and unblocking the hardest technical problems.

 AI-Native Development. AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude, Code, and agentic workflows every day, and our product is built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows. You’ll set the bar for how your team uses them.

 Customers at the Center. Talk directly with customers to understand their problems, and make sure your team builds things that create real value for them.

 Own Technical Direction. Make the architecture and design calls for your team’s problem space, and own the trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability.

 Work with Modern Technology. TypeScript across the stack, React, Postgres, and AWS serverless (Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions. Datadog, Meticulous, and Incident.io round it out.

 Shape the Roadmap. Work with your PM and Designer on prioritisation, scoping, and sequencing so the team ships what matters most.

 Build the Team. Interview, hire, and onboard new engineers as we double in size.

  
 About You

 You’re a highly technical full-stack engineer. You’ve designed and shipped web apps end to end in TypeScript, ideally on AWS serverless, and you’re still one of the strongest engineers in the room.

 You’ve led engineers. You’ve been a Tech Lead, Team Lead, or TLM, owning delivery and technical direction for a team.

 You want to manage people, or grow into it. Ideally, you’ve line-managed engineers already. If not, you’re keen to learn.

 You still love to build. Leading hasn’t pulled you away from the code, and you want a role where you keep shipping.

 You raise the bar. You know what well-architected, reliable software looks like, and you help others get there through reviews, pairing, and clear feedback.

 You’re motivated by customer impact. You care about outcomes for customers, not just output, and you make good calls on what to build and what to cut.

 You’re a strong partner. You work well with product and design, push back when it matters, and bring people with you.

 You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You can take an unclear problem, shape it, and get a team moving on it.

  
 Nice-to-Haves

 You’ve led a team through fast growt

jobs.title: Scientific Product Manager
jobs.description:
About CuspAI 
 CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

 We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. 
 
 The Role 
 Due to rapid growth in our partner lab network, we are seeking a Scientific Product Manager to join our Product team and bring partner labs and their experimental workflows onto the CuspAI platform.
 
 Your impact 
 This is an exciting opportunity to join the product team at CuspAI, working closely with materials scientists, ML researchers and platform engineers to make AI-driven experimentation work in real laboratories. As one of a small team of Scientific Product Managers, you will take ownership of a set of partner labs and the lab integration work around them, translating what each lab actually needs into requirements our engineers and ML researchers can build against. Alongside the product work, you will spend real time with your partners' teams and their experimental data.
 
 What You Will Do 
 Product Requirements & Roadmap 
 Shape and prioritise the roadmap for how experimental data, protocols and campaigns get into the CuspAI platform, together with your fellow Scientific Product Managers, the engineering lead and the wider product team.

 Write requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from, covering experiment types, instrument integrations and LIMS/ELN connections, and work with the data team on the underlying data models and provenance.

 Contribute to decisions on what we build, what we integrate, and what we leave to partners' existing systems.

 Partner Lab Onboarding 
 Lead technical discovery with the partner labs you take on: map their workflows, instruments, sample logic and data systems, and pin down the true experimental unit and the parameters that matter.

 Own onboarding for your partner labs from scoping to the first closed-loop campaign, and turn each onboarding into reusable patterns and documentation shared across the team so the next one is faster.

 Act as the main scientific counterpart for the partner labs you look after, and represent the product in partner meetings, workshops and conferences.

 Closed-Loop Campaigns 
 Work with ML researchers to design optimisation campaigns (e.g. Bayesian optimisation) that respect real experimental constraints such as throughput, noise and failed samples.

 Define how platform-driven campaigns are validated, including benchmarks against manual or legacy workflows, success metrics and the evidence we bring to partners.

 
 Must Have Skills and Qualifications: 
 PhD in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering or a related experimental discipline, or equivalent experience in scientific research.

 Hands-on experience with high-throughput or automated experimentation (e.g. robotic synthesis, combinatorial libraries, automated characterisation, or self-driving / closed-loop labs) in industry, a national lab or research institute, or academia.

 Proven track record of translating scientific or process needs into requirements for engineers, software teams or automation vendors, and of validating that what was built works in the lab.

 Firsthand understanding of how experimental data is produced and where it fails: which metadata and provenance matter, instrument quirks, data quality issues, and what makes a dataset usable for machine learning.

 Depth in at least one materials domain (e.g. semiconductors and thin films including photovoltaics, catalysis and electrochemistry, energy materials including batteries, polymers and formulations, or separations and surfaces) and the curiosity to work across others.

 Working knowledge of Python for data handling and analysis; comfortable working with APIs and data schemas.

 Strong communicator and a proven collaborator, comfortable working directly with external partner labs as well as multidisciplinary science, ML, product and engineering teams.

 
 Bonus Points (But Not Critical): 
 Direct experience with closed-loop optimisation in an automated setting, such as Bayesian optimisation, active learning or design of experiments.

 Experience with research data management, LIMS/ELN systems, FAIR

 Du übernimmst dein eigenes Portfolio an Firmenkunden. Du entscheidest, welche Unterkünfte wir anbieten, setzt die Preise, verhandelst mit Hotels und bist die feste Ansprechperson für deine Kunden. Kein Zuarbeiten, keine Freigabeschleifen für jede Kleinigkeit: Du trägst Verantwortung für das Ergebnis.
 Über MyFlexHome 
 MyFlexHome ist die smarte Buchungslösung für Unternehmensbuchungen und Projektteams. Mit unserem Booking Board organisieren wir Übernachtungen für ganze Projektteams, etwa auf Baustellen, bei Montageeinsätzen oder Workshops, und verbinden Unternehmen mit passenden Unterkünften in ganz Deutschland.
 Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes StartUp im WERK1 München. Wir arbeiten mit eigenen Tools und KI-gestützten Abläufen, damit Zeit für das bleibt, was zählt: gute Entscheidungen für unsere Kunden.
 Deine Verantwortung: 
 Eigene Kunden: Du betreust ein festes Portfolio an Firmenkunden eigenständig im Tagesgeschäft und bist ihre erste und feste Ansprechperson.

 Angebote und Preise: Du recherchierst Hotels, Serviced Apartments und Ferienwohnungen, entscheidest über die passenden Optionen und erstellst Angebote inklusive Preissetzung in einem klar abgesteckten Rahmen.

 Verhandlung: Du verhandelst Raten, Kontingente und Stornobedingungen mit Hotels und verantwortest das wirtschaftliche Ergebnis deiner Projekte.

 Laufende Projekte: Du steuerst mehrere parallele Projekte, setzt Prioritäten selbst und löst kurzfristige Änderungen, Probleme und Eskalationen eigenständig.

 Kommunikation: Du führst die gesamte Kunden- und Hotelkommunikation, auf Deutsch und bei Bedarf auf Englisch.

 Prozesse: Du arbeitest in unserem Buchungssystem und gestaltest Abläufe und Tools aktiv mit. Was dich ausbremst, verbesserst du.

 Das brauchst du: 
 Lust auf (und bestenfalls Erfahrung in der) Organisation von Hotelbuchungen – egal ob auf Anbieter- oder Kundenseite (z. B. Hotellerie, Reisebüro, Eventagentur, Office Management oder Projektassistenz)

 Lust (und bestenfalls Erfahrung damit), Verantwortung für Ergebnisse zu tragen, etwa für eigene Kunden, Projekte, Budgets oder einen eigenen Bereich

 Verhandlungsgeschick und ein gutes Gespür für Menschen sowie für Zahlen und Kalkulation

 Lust, mit KI-Tools und Automatisierung zu arbeiten

 Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gutes Englisch

 Die Fähigkeit, viele Projekte parallel zu steuern und auch bei kurzfristigen Änderungen ruhig zu entscheiden – mit Organisationstalent und Detailgenauigkeit

 Ein Plus, aber kein Muss: 
 Berufserfahrung in der Hotellerie, im Business Travel, im MICE- oder Gruppengeschäft oder in der Reservierung

 Sicherheit bei Ratenstrukturen, Kontingenten und Stornobedingungen

 Erfahrung mit Hotel- oder Buchungssystemen wie Opera, Buchungsportalen oder einem CRM

 Erfahrung in einem Startup oder kleinen Team

 Ein Netzwerk zu Hotels in Deutschland

 Du hast bisher in einem Unternehmen die Unterkünfte für Mitarbeitende oder Projektteams organisiert, neben vielen anderen Aufgaben? Dann kennst du unser Geschäft aus Kundensicht, und genau das ist für uns wertvoll.
 Ehrlich gesagt passt die Rolle nicht zu dir, wenn du lieber nach klaren Anweisungen arbeitest, feste Abläufe bevorzugst oder Entscheidungen grundsätzlich absichern möchtest. Bei uns gilt: lieber gut begründet entscheiden als perfekt abwarten.
 Was wir bieten: 
 Ein eigenes Kundenportfolio mit echter Entscheidungsfreiheit statt Zuarbeit

 Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründerteam und kurze Entscheidungswege

 Viel Gestaltungsspielraum bei Prozessen und Tools, inklusive moderner KI-Unterstützung

 27 Urlaubstage plus Weihnachten und Silvester frei

 50 € steuerfreier Sachbezug pro Monat

 Ein Büro im WERK1 München

 Hybrides Arbeiten möglich

 Vollzeit, Start ab sofort

 Du bist nicht „nur“ im Reisebüro. Du arbeitest an einer digitalen Lösung, die Unterkünfte für ganze Unternehmen organisiert, und prägst mit, wie wir wachsen.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Marketplace
jobs.description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

We’re looking for Product Managers to join Vinted Marketplace within our Security domain. The Security domain protects member accounts and keeps the platform safe by securing sign-up and login for both individuals and businesses. We prevent fake or malicious registrations and automated bot activity, manage email/phone verification and two-factor authentication, reduce account takeovers, detect inappropriate multiple-account use, and build the core systems that power identity, verification, and additional security checks when needed.

Depending on your experience and interests, you will join one of three teams tackling meaningful problems for our business and members:

Multiple Accounts: Shape how multiple accounts and profiles work on Vinted, with an immediate priority on creating a safe, easy-to-use experience for minors and teens (including parental controls, compliance, and safety mechanisms), while expanding support for broader usage patterns.

Registration: Protect genuine users while preventing malicious actors, focusing on end-to-end registration flows, UX-first adaptive registration, and defense mechanisms against bot activity.

Verification: Own email/phone verification (2FA), identity check mechanisms, and friction platforms, ensuring seamless, scalable verification for genuine members while stopping compromised or fake accounts.

In close partnership with teams across your domain and neighboring areas, you’ll collaborate with Product Design, Product Analytics, Engineering, and cross-functional leadership to drive real impact.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Drive and align the vision, product strategy, and measurable OKRs for your ownership area, connecting member problems to business opportunities.
  • Conduct rigorous product discovery, framing complex member, safety, security, and business problems using both qualitative research and quantitative analytics.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Research, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Member Support, and external 3rd-party vendors.
  • Understand end-to-end user journeys, technical architecture constraints, safety signals, and platform ecosystem dynamics for both genuine users and malicious actors.
  • Oversee the product development cycle using agile methodologies, making clear trade-offs, managing roadmaps, running hypothesis-based experiments (A/B testing), and iterating based on data.
  • Ensure regulatory, legal, and security requirements are integrated into product decisions from the start without compromising a smooth member journey.
  • Bring clarity to ambiguous problem spaces and communicate effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders and leadership.

About you 

  • Several years of product management experience in a fast-paced, cross-functional tech environment, with a track record across the full product lifecycle.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Generative AI Platform
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat. DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt now operate as one global company. Behind the AI experiences millions of people use every day, from shopping assistants to customer support agents, sits one shared Generative AI platform. Our team builds it.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager in London to own major parts of that platform. Your customers are the engineers and ML researchers across all three brands who build AI products and agents. You'll work with engineering and product leaders in Europe and the US, and your decisions will shape how AI gets built across every market we operate in.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Set the strategy and roadmap for core parts of our GenAI platform: model access and routing, agent infrastructure, and evaluation and observability.
  • Build one platform for three brands. Spot the patterns across Deliveroo, Wolt and DoorDash teams and turn them into shared building blocks, so a capability built once reaches every market.
  • Shape our model portfolio across frontier and open-weight models. Decide where we build, buy or partner in an ecosystem that changes month to month.
  • Make agents production-ready. Give teams safe access to company knowledge, tools and systems, with the quality, latency and cost controls needed to run agents at scale.
  • Own the evaluation strategy so teams can prove quality before launch and keep improving it after.
  • Stay close to your customers. Work with the teams shipping AI experiences, measure adoption and time-to-production, and let real production use drive the roadmap.
  • Lead at a senior level,  presenting to senior technical leadership and influence strategy beyond your own roadmap.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate brings deep expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Significant product management experience (typically 8+ years, or equivalent), including owning a technical platform, developer product, or ML or data infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based products or platforms in production, such as assistants, agents, evaluation or inference. GenAI platforms are a young field, so we care more about depth than years.
  • A platform mindset. You notice the problem five teams keep solving and turn it into one capability everyone can use.
  • The ability to go deep with engineers and ML researchers, then explain the trade-off in plain language to a senior leader.
  • A track record of leading large, ambiguous areas on your own and aligning stakeholders across companies, countries and time zones.
  • Comfort with regular overlap with US time zones, including some late-afternoon and evening calls.

What Success Looks Like

A team in any of our three brands can go from idea to a reliable AI product dramatically faster. That happens because the hard parts (models, inference, evaluation, tooling, observability, governance and agent infrastructure) are solved once at the platform layer and get better for everyone.

Why Join Us?

  • Real scale from day one. Your platform powers AI used by millions of consumers, merchants and couriers across three brands.
  • Frontier work, real constraints. You'll work with the latest models and agent patterns, then make them reliable, affordable and compliant in production.
  • Visible impact. Platform decisions here get reviewed by senior leadership and adopted across the company.

 

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.
